task: Parse an AWS S3 bucket name from a full S3 URI (e.g., 's3://my-bucket-name/path/to/file.txt') and extract just the bucket name
solutionCriteria: The regex should correctly match and capture bucket names from S3 URIs, handling standard S3 naming conventions (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens)

task: Create a JSON configuration object for an AWS Lambda function that specifies the function name, runtime (Node.js 18), memory (256MB), timeout (30 seconds), and environment variables for a database connection string
solutionCriteria: The JSON should be valid, include all required AWS Lambda configuration fields, and properly structure nested objects for environment variables

task: Write a JavaScript function that takes an AWS IAM ARN string (e.g., 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/username') and returns an object containing the account ID and the resource name (username)
solutionCriteria: The function should correctly parse ARN format, extract the account ID (12-digit number) and resource identifier, and return an object with properties for each component
